applied.quote: The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) depreciates residential rental buildings over 27.5 years under the general depreciation system (GDS), according to [IRS Publication 527](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p527).

applied.quote: The strategy stops working in three situations: the appraisal comes in low, lender seasoning rules or the six-month delayed financing cap limit the loan, or the new loan payment is more than the rent brings in.

applied.quote: If the purchase money came from an unsecured loan or a loan on another asset, such as a HELOC on another property, the refinance settlement statement must show all cash-out proceeds paying off or paying down that loan.
applied.replacement: If the purchase money came from an unsecured loan or a loan on another asset, such as a HELOC on another property, all cash-out proceeds must pay off or pay down that loan. The refinance settlement statement must show it.
